method.startup_interval: Before MCP process launch through the first completed assignment, including MCP initialization and tool discovery.
method.warm_interval: One complete public send call after the first assignment.
method.dependency_preparation: None: existing Python executable and published R library selected; ir/uv absent from child PATH; R resolution disabled.
method.execution: Direct, with normal Console recording in a new temporary workspace per launch.
method.cache_state: Installed-runtime caches remain warm; each launch uses fresh Jupyter and IPython configuration directories.
method.memory: ps RSS after warm cells for Console and all descendants; includes shared-page double counting, excludes benchmark client, is not peak RSS.
method.sample_order: Round robin in listed variant order, one new launch per variant per round.
